blind.description: A square stone architectural pillar or pedestal featuring carved dark stone cap and base, between which are stacked bulging egg-like sacs bundled together by thick webbing cords. Several stylized black spiders with pale yellowish-green markings cling to the webbing and egg sacs on the front and sides.
blind.from_above: A square dark grey stone block with carved surface bevels/grooves, with the rounded contours of bulging egg sacs and a couple of small spider shapes protruding slightly beyond its perimeter.
blind.height_vs_figure: Slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 5 ft tall), and roughly 1.5 to 2 ft wide.
